nodes.label: Match the voice - Fit the
nodes.text: Match the voice - Fit the intended tone (formal, casual, technical). Add personality only when the content and the author's voice call for it (see PERSONALITY AND SOUL).

nodes.label: Match those habits instead of merely
nodes.text: Match those habits instead of merely deleting AI patterns. Do not upgrade casual words or regularize deliberate quirks.

nodes.label: Avoiding AI patterns is only half
nodes.text: Avoiding AI patterns is only half the job. Sterile, voiceless writing is just as obvious as slop. Good writing has a human behind it.

nodes.label: Words to watch: boasts a, vibrant
nodes.text: Words to watch: boasts a, vibrant, rich (figurative), profound, enhancing its, showcasing, exemplifies, commitment to, natural beauty, nestled, in the heart of, groundbreaking (figurative), renowned, breathtaking, must-visit, stunning

nodes.label: (If a real source exists, name
nodes.text: (If a real source exists, name it. Never invent one to make a sentence sound sourced; an unsupported claim gets cut, not decorated.)
